person_note: The body of the novel is sustained third-person narration centered on Maya, supported by diagnostic quotes and authorized excerpts. A final chapter set twenty-five years later switches to Shane's first person, but that terminal framing exception is not a co-controlling base strand under the clarified rule. The book-level base narration is therefore THIRD.
